data.name: Forbidden Chakra Dragon
data.description: This forbidden jutsu taps into the very essence of chakra, manifesting a spectral dragon made of pure energy. The dragon's form shimmers with ethereal power, exuding an aura that disrupts the flow of chakra in the area.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes the Forbidden Chakra Dragon, a colossal serpent of crackling chakra that coils around %target, its radiant form pulsating with an ominous glow. As the dragon tightens its grip, %target's chakra channels are twisted and distorted, causing their Bukijutsu abilities to falter and wane. Each attempt to muster a technique is met with resistance, the dragon draining their skill and proficiency with each passing moment.

data.name: Lightning Release: Spark Blade
data.description: The user channels lightning chakra into their blade, causing it to crackle with electricity upon contact, delivering a shocking jolt to the target.
data.battleDescription: %user channels lightning chakra into their blade, causing it to crackle with electrifying energy. With a swift and precise strike, %user slashes through the air, releasing a dazzling display of sparks. Upon contact, the blade delivers a shocking jolt to %target, causing them to convulse from the electrical surge. While %target is on the ground %user siphons their health from them.

data.name: Inferno Cyclone
data.description: Creates a rotating column of fire.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a blazing cyclone, engulfing %target in flames that sap their strength and resolve.

data.name: Elemental Combo Test 1
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %user uses %jutsu on %target

data.name: Terra Shield
data.description: Creates a protective shield of solid rock.
data.battleDescription: %user raises their weapon, channeling earth chakra to summon a massive shield of solid rock. This defensive technique can block incoming attacks and protect %user and their allies. The Terra Shield is incredibly durable, capable of withstanding powerful blows and providing a strategic advantage in battle.

data.name: Cleansing Aura
data.description: A non-elemental jutsu that purges the user of all negative status effects, including residuals and debuffs.
data.battleDescription: %user forms a series of deliberate hand seals, creating a radiant aura of pure chakra that surrounds their body. The cleansing energy washes over %user, dispelling all negative status effects and restoring %user to their optimal state.

data.name: Phantom Gale
data.description: A powerful genjutsu that unleashes an ethereal wind assault, dealing heavy damage and overwhelming the target's senses.
data.battleDescription: %user channels intense chakra into the air, weaving an illusion that bends wind into spectral blades. As the winds roar and converge around %target, their vision fractures—phantoms of slicing gales lashing from every direction. The illusion feels real, striking with such precision and force that even the ground trembles underfoot. Each gust tears into the senses, making escape feel impossible as %target is enveloped by a tempest of illusory devastation.

data.name: Dark Pact
data.description: Forbiden jutsu forging pact with outer god Rilliam
data.battleDescription: %user concentrates, piercing the barrier between Seichi and the great Wall, home of the Rilliam dweller of walls, bitter of ankles, to present a sacrifice in return for fortitude.

data.name: Riptide Reaper
data.description: A ruthless water-based bukijutsu that deals damage and restores health through lifesteal.
data.battleDescription: %user strikes with Riptide Reaper, channeling a surge of cursed water through their weapon to tear into %target, stealing life with every slash like the tide dragging its prey into the abyss.

data.name: Gust Armor
data.description: The user surrounds themselves with a layer of dense wind chakra, providing temporary protection against physical attacks and increasing agility.
data.battleDescription: As %user channels wind chakra, a swirling vortex envelops them, forming a protective barrier of dense air. This Gust Armor increases %user's defense, creating a buffer againstthe opponent's attacks. The swirling winds around %user deflect incoming strikes, reducing the impact and enhancing %user's resilience against harm.

data.name: Spectral Chain
data.description: A spectral genjutsu that deals damage and prevents the user from being stunned.
data.battleDescription: %user performs a swift, entrancing sequence of hand seals. Spectral chains erupt from the void around %target, latching onto their mind and spirit. The illusion tightens with each pulse, sending jolts of phantom pain and confusion through their senses. As the chains bind %target in this nightmarish loop, the user is enveloped in a stabilizing aura, making them immune to stunning interruptions while the illusion holds.

data.name: Penguin Shuffle
data.description: The user channels chakra into their legs, allowing them to slide gracefully across the battlefield as though skating on ice. The smooth, silent movement leaves a shimmering icy trail behind, with fleeting images of playful penguins appearing in their wake. This technique not only enhances their speed but also reduces the impact of incoming attacks as they glide with uncanny precision.
data.battleDescription: %user swaps places with a life-sized snow penguin, which collapses into a pile of snow upon impact, leaving %target bewildered. %user reappears a short distance away, poised to counter.

data.name: Crushing Tides
data.description: A relentless water attack that deals damage over time.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes surging waves that engulf %target, continuously wearing them down.

data.name: KGK: Black Fang Lance
data.description: A concentrated piercing technique utilized by Kuroganekai execution units to overwhelm enemy defenses through relentless offensive pressure. Black Fang Lance condenses violent chakra around the user’s strike, driving through targets with enough force to amplify subsequent attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user lunges while forging a spear of violet chakra and takes shape into a ravenous beast of energy roaring towards %target that tears forward in a brutal piercing assault.

data.name: Flame Barrage
data.description: A mobile blaze assault that scorches the enemy and leaves them exposed to intensified ninjutsu damage.
data.battleDescription: %user blazes across the battlefield, launching a spread of fireballs from shifting positions that hammer into %target. The impacts disrupt their chakra defenses, amplifying the damage they take from future ninjutsu techniques.

data.name: Iron Fist
data.description: Channel chakra into your fist, hardening it like iron, and strike the ground.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra, empowering their fist. They strike at %target with raw force, shattering their bones.

data.name: Phantom Scythe
data.description: A spectral slash that deals damage and increases the opponent's chakra and stamina usage.
data.battleDescription: %user swings a ghostly scythe that cuts deeper than flesh, striking %target with a draining force that lingers within their body. The blow warps their flow of energy, causing every jutsu they cast to draw more chakra and stamina than before.

data.name: Lightning Surge
data.description: A lightning attack that stuns the enemy
data.battleDescription: %user channels crackling electricity into %target, shocking them continuously.

data.name: Water Release: Heavy Rain
data.description: Cover the battle field in a torrent of rain.
data.battleDescription: %user calls forth a torrent of water around the battlefield

data.name: Earth Style: Shattering Kick
data.description: A powerful taijutsu kick that deals damage to the opponent
data.battleDescription: %user charges forward and plants their weight before delivering a crushing upward kick infused with earth chakra. The ground beneath their foot cracks as force surges through the strike, launching the target backward with seismic impact. The attack not only causes direct damage but also knocks the enemy across the battlefield, breaking their formation and control.

data.name: Wind Vacuum
data.description: A jutsu that increases the user’s wind damage output.
data.battleDescription: %user draws in surrounding air with a deep inhalation, forming an intense vacuum around their body. As the pressure equalizes, their chakra surges violently, amplifying the force and sharpness of their wind-based techniques. The surrounding atmosphere distorts slightly, signaling the enhanced potential of their next wind release.

data.name: Limit Breaker
data.description: A taijutsu stance that surges the user’s power while suppressing the enemy’s ability to strike back.
data.battleDescription: %user tightens their stance, breathing slow and deep as raw fighting spirit surges through their limbs. Muscles tense. Focus sharpens. Taijutsu power spikes violently—strikes hit harder, movements become instinctive. At the same time, the user’s aura emits crushing pressure that destabilizes %target’s combat rhythm, weakening their offensive output.

data.name: Bonecrusher Kick
data.description: A brutal close-range kick that weakens the enemy’s overall combat capabilities.
data.battleDescription: %user charges forward, planting one foot with brutal precision as their leg whips into a wide, crushing arc. The kick slams into %target with raw, unfiltered force—striking deep into the nervous system and chakra flow. The impact causes more than just physical pain; it scrambles coordination, drains resolve, and fogs concentration. Strength and Speed are dulled, while Willpower and Intelligence flicker under the weight of the blow.

data.name: Bursting Compressed Air
data.description: A ninjutsu that deals damage using a blast of condensed air.
data.battleDescription: %user compresses air with precise chakra control into a tightly packed orb between their palms. With a sharp thrust, the orb explodes forward, releasing a concentrated shockwave that tears through the air. The blast distorts the surroundings as it barrels toward the target, hitting with the crushing force of pure atmospheric pressure.

data.name: Typhon Burst
data.description: The user condenses wind charka in their palm. Releasing the charka generates a blast of wind in the direction in which their palms point.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a chaotic gale that slashes into %target, scattering their strength to the winds while infusing themselves with stormborne power.

data.name: Fiend Fire
data.description: A destructive fire jutsu that scorches on impact and continues to burn over time.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures an unstable mass of fire chakra, shaping it into a spiraling flame that howls as it tears through the air. Upon impact with %target, the blast erupts violently, igniting their body with cursed flame. The initial strike sears flesh and chakra alike, while the lingering fire continues to eat away at their endurance long after contact.

data.name: Earth Release: Boulder Crush
data.description: he user lifts a massive boulder infused with earth chakra and slams it down onto the target, causing heavy damage.
data.battleDescription: %user channels Earth Release chakra, summoning a colossal boulder above %target. With a commanding motion, they hurl it downward, shattering it on impact and bombarding %target with debris. The force of the crash creates a shockwave, leaving %target staggered and exposed.

data.name: Enjin
data.description: A technique that envelops the user’s weapon in flames, boosting their speed and power with every strike.
data.battleDescription: %user weapon bursts into flames, the intense heat warping the air around them. With every swing, the flames grow fiercer, their strikes gaining momentum and power. The weapon becomes an extension of %user’s fiery will, cutting through defenses like a hot knife through butter, and leaving behind trails of searing heat that scorch the battlefield.

data.name: Forbidden Art: Eclipse Nerve Sutra
data.description: A forbidden genjutsu that writes dark scripture directly across the target's nervous system, locking pain and hesitation into the body.

effects.description: Eclipse scripture damages the target's senses.
The target's nerves seize under forbidden script.
The target's attacks lose force and timing.
The scripture rejects all blessings from the user.

data.battleDescription: %user traces a circle over one eye, and the battlefield dims under an artificial eclipse. Black sutra characters crawl through the air and stitch themselves into %target's nerves. Every thought becomes a delayed command, every breath a misfire, while %user stands perfectly still, unable to receive any blessing until the scripture fades.

data.name: Fury of The White Tiger
data.description: Open seven of the eight inner gates to release a devastating strike at the target
data.battleDescription: Waves of green and blue energy flow from %user `s body as %user opens the first seven Inner Gates. Each Gate increases their  strength and speed significantly, engulfing %user with an all repelling aura of pure power. %user goes into the Tiger stance before striking the air in front of them with  an explosion of power. The violent punch sends a massive tiger-shaped shockwave at %target.

data.name: Multi-Layered Gale
data.description: The user creates a wall of multiple layers of vacuum that are stacked on top of each other
data.battleDescription: %user summons multiple wind currents that converge on %target, cutting deep and sapping their strength.

data.name: Phantom Guilt
data.description: Implants illusions of guilt and remorse in the target's mind, forcing them to relive past mistakes and creating a profound sense of self-loathing.
data.battleDescription: %user invokes Phantom Guilt, implanting illusions within %target's mind. The illusions compel the %target to relive past mistakes, fostering a deep sense of guilt and self-loathing. %user capitalizes on  %target weakened state, executing precise strikes that exploit their distracted defenses.

data.name: Void Crush
data.description: A crushing wave of void chakra that damages the enemy and suppresses their overall offensive power.
data.battleDescription: %user compresses a mass of void chakra and hurls it at %target, crushing them beneath invisible pressure. The impact distorts their chakra pathways and dulls their focus, weakening all forms of offensive output across physical and spiritual disciplines.

data.name: Hittakuri
data.description: A devastating ninjutsu that tears through the battlefield, stealing the valuables of its target
data.battleDescription: %user forms a complex series of hand seals, focusing their chakra into a swirling, pitch-black void that materializes in the air. The rift pulses with dark energy, and with a flick of %user’s hand, it lashes out reaching into %target pockets

data.name: Thunderous Echo
data.description: The user creates an illusion of a deafening thunderclap, disorienting the target and momentarily dulling their senses.
data.battleDescription: As %user performs Thunderous Echo, %target is engulfed in a deafening roar of thunder. The sound reverberates in %target's ears, causing disorientation and pain. The thunderous echo lingers, disrupting %target's concentration and inflicting ongoing damage, like a relentless storm wearing down a sturdy tree.

data.name: Solar Dragon Strike
data.description: Ignite your blade and unleash a strike that burns through power of the sun
data.battleDescription: %user unsheathes a magnificent blade, holding it high in the sky the light of the sun catches the tip of the blade and ignites it. A Dragon slowly forms from the tip of the blade to the handle. Holding the blade with two hands %user swings it downward, as the blade moves through the air it ignites everything within it's path cleaving a path of fire towards %target. Due to increase heat however, %user finds burn marks around their hands.

data.name: Small Chakra Barrier
data.description: User produces a barrier of chakra to protect them from attacks
data.battleDescription: %user performs hand signs and stretches out their arm creating a barrier of Chakra infront of them

data.name: Thunderous Knee Strike
data.description: A close-range knee strike that delivers heavy impact and suppresses enemy offensive power.
data.battleDescription: %user lunges forward with explosive speed, chakra tightening around their core as they drive a sharp knee into %target’s abdomen. The impact sends a thunderous shock through the target’s body, disrupting chakra circulation and muscular focus. The blow rattles the center of their offense—cutting power from their strikes, reducing precision, and softening their follow-through

data.name: Whispering Winds
data.description: A ghostly breeze slices through the air, dealing damage and making the target more vulnerable to genjutsu.
data.battleDescription: With a gentle sway of the hand, the shinobi summons a spectral wind that whistles with haunted whispers. The gust slashes through %target’s senses, disrupting their mental clarity and unraveling their resistance to illusion. The eerie presence lingers, amplifying the effects of genjutsu to come.

data.name: Drowning Smash
data.description: Smash your opponent with liquid fists.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra, shaping water into a gleaming Liquid Fist. With a swift motion, they propel it forward, striking %target with deceptive speed and unrelenting force.

data.name: Chains of Sorrow
data.description: The user casts an illusion on the target, making them perceive heavy, restrictive shackles binding their limbs and torso. Despite being an illusion, the target feels the weight and constriction, which can cause panic and hinder movement.
data.battleDescription: With a swift hand movement, %user casts Illusionary Shackles on %target. %target suddenly feels heavy, invisible shackles constricting their body, slowing their movements and inducing a sense of helplessness. The illusion is so convincing that %target struggles to break free, unaware that they are trapped in a genjutsu.

data.name: Surging Water Slicer
data.description: The user summons a linear wave of water that shoots outward from the ground at high speeds to its target. It is strong enough to slice clean through rock.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a linear wave of water that shoots outward from the ground at high speeds towards %target. It is strong enough to slice clean through rock.

data.name: Tempest of Shadows
data.description: A sharp genjutsu that strikes with piercing force and leaves the enemy more vulnerable to future genjutsu attacks.
data.battleDescription: With a silent breath, %user extends their hand, distorting the light and shadows around them into a whirling maelstrom of razor-sharp illusions. The air tears open before %target as spectral blades howl through the storm, piercing mind and body alike. Every cut amplifies the target’s susceptibility to genjutsu, warping their perception and weakening their mental defenses. The storm does not relent—it lingers in the mind, twisting all future illusions into inescapable torment.

data.name: Tides of Sovereignty
data.description: Summoning the might of the endless sea, the user commands the tides to swell their power—amplifying the force of every water-based assault with sovereign wrath.
data.battleDescription: %user draws deep from their water chakra reserves, their movements becoming smooth, forceful, and unrelenting like a rising tide. Each strike is infused with hydraulic pressure, reinforcing every blow with the crushing strength of flowing currents. The user’s water-based techniques become more destructive, mirroring the power of sovereign tides.

data.name: Torrent Blade
data.description: The user channels their chakra into their sword and infuses it with water release. This blade can cut through solid objects, and the current can knock opponents off balance.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into their sword, infusing it with water. The blade transforms, shimmering with liquid energy. With a swift motion, they slash through the air, creating a blade of pressurized water.

data.name: Stone Labyrinth
data.description: Creates an illusion of an endless stone maze.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves intricate hand seals, causing the ground to tremble as an illusory stone labyrinth rises around %target. The towering walls twist and turn, leading %target into a disorienting maze with no apparent exit. As %target navigates the endless corridors, they are plagued by feelings of confusion and claustrophobia, making it difficult to focus on the battle.

data.name: Rensa Kaminari
data.description: A chaining lightning technique that enhances the user’s power while weakening the opponent’s mental and chakra resilience.
data.battleDescription: %user channels a concentrated flow of lightning chakra through their body, heightening their offensive capabilities. Sparks then arc across the battlefield toward %target, surging through their chakra network and diminishing their resistance to ninjutsu by weakening their intelligence, willpower, and ninjutsu defenses.

data.name: Shadow Onslaught
data.description: A sinister jujutsu that increases the users Genjutsu damage
data.battleDescription: %user activates Shadow Onslaught, veiling themselves in illusory darkness that twists their genjutsu into sharper, crueler weapons.

data.name: Seismic Hammer
data.description: Transforms weapon into a seismic hammer to stun enemies.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into their weapon, transforming it into a seismic hammer. With a powerful slam into the ground, a shockwave erupts, traveling toward %target. The impact sends tremors through their body, stunning them and leaving them vulnerable to further attacks.

data.name: Forbidden Art: Soul Furnace Reversal
data.description: A forbidden yin-yang ninjutsu that turns the user's chakra core into a furnace, stealing vitality while making the body dangerously brittle.

effects.description: A soul furnace burns the target from within.
The user siphons vitality from inflicted damage.
The target's ability to recover is scorched away.
The stolen heat leaves the user's body brittle.

data.battleDescription: %user exhales black flame from their palms and shapes it into a furnace door behind %target's spirit. The door swings open, dragging heat, breath, and willpower from %target into %user's chest. Wounds seal for a moment, but the stolen vitality burns too hot; %user's skin fractures with pale light, leaving them dangerously easy to break.

data.name: Electric Maul
data.description: Your electric-infused chakra races toward an opponent like a tiger, mauling them to shreds.
data.battleDescription: The user slams their palm into the earth, channeling lightning chakra through the terrain. From the surge, a roaring tiger made entirely of crackling electricity erupts into view, its body outlined in streaks of blinding light. The beast charges the enemy with terrifying speed, pouncing and delivering a mauling strike of raw elemental force. This genin-level jutsu strikes fear into opponents through its fierce visual and devastating impact.

data.name: Ignition Kick
data.description: This technique focuses on utilizing fire elemental chakra on the leg to erupt in fire as it makes contact with the opponent.
data.battleDescription: %user channels fire chakra into their leg, delivering a swift roundhouse kick to %target. The impact erupts in a burst of flames, scorching %target and leaving them staggered.

data.name: Chakra Ignition Strike
data.description: A devastating chakra blow that shatters the enemy’s power and fortifies the user’s defenses.
data.battleDescription: The ground trembles as %user channels dense chakra into their strike, their aura flaring with violent intensity. When their fist collides with %target, the impact detonates in a blinding surge of force, sending cracks spidering through the earth. The backlash drains the enemy’s power, their strength faltering under the oppressive pressure, while %user’s body hardens with reinforced chakra, every breath radiating unshakable defense.

data.battleDescription: %user uses %jutsu on %target

data.name: Grasp of the White Hunt
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %user uses %jutsu on %target

data.name: Electric Ensnare
data.description: Unleashe a torrent of lightning, coiling around the opponent like serpentine tendrils
data.battleDescription: %user summons crackling electric currents that coil around %target, stunning them with jolts of energy.

data.name: Illusionary Celestial Mirage
data.description: A genjutsu that deals damage and creates a protective barrier around the user.
data.battleDescription: %user’s hands weave an elegant sequence as the battlefield warps into a vision of divine starscapes. Blinding celestial illusions rain down upon %target, searing their mind with radiant bursts. As the vision fades, shimmering threads of starlight remain coiled around %user, forming a protective barrier.

data.name: Leviathan's Nova
data.description: A water-element Genjutsu that engulfs the target’s mind with a vision of a colossal, deep-sea leviathan rising from the ocean's abyss.
data.battleDescription: %user begins by forming a series of complex hand seals, channeling deep water chakra into the surrounding environment. %target suddenly finds themselves transported beneath an immense ocean, the water dark and oppressive around them. As they struggle to comprehend their situation, a gigantic leviathan emerges from the darkness, its eyes glowing ominously in the abyssal light.  The creature opens its vast maw, and in a moment of horror, %target is swallowed whole. The overwhelming fear and the illusion of digestive acids burning them.

data.name: Mizushibari
data.description: A water-based strike that crushes the enemy and siphons incoming damage away from the user.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a burst of high-pressure water that lashes out toward %target, striking with force before swirling around their own body. The lingering vortex hardens like fluid armor, absorbing a portion of the damage from enemy attacks that follow.

data.name: Stone Dance Slash
data.description: A fierce earth-based slash that delivers crushing damage with precision and force.
data.battleDescription: %user channels seismic chakra into their weapon and dashes toward %target, unleashing a spiraling slash infused with the force of crumbling mountains. A vortex of rotating stones surrounds the user, creating a shifting defense and amplifying the power of the strike. The impact sends jagged rock fragments flying, shaking the ground beneath and leaving a cracked, ruptured battlefield in its wake.

data.name: New Jutsu - UOWVfFj7Rub-T_0cOYpMd
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %user uses %jutsu on %target

data.name: Flash Pulse
data.description: Channel your chakra into the your body to increase your attack potency and damage resistance.
data.battleDescription: %user claps their hand together releasing a massive pulse of chakra. Their body becomes tougher and their muscles bulk up with energy.

data.name: Gaze into Yomi
data.description: A Forbidden Jutsu that brings your opponents loves ones to the battlefield
data.battleDescription: %user forms hand-seals whilst smoke transpires from their body. The smoke causes a rapidly expending cloud, engulfing %user from sight. %target feels a cold chill running down their back as the area around them turns grey, all color draining from their vision. The smoke, which materializes into spirit-like aberrations that carry the likeliness of deceased family, floats around %target, softly wailing in agony as they close in on %target

data.name: Moose Cleave
data.description: Unleash beams of chakra from the eyes to obliterate enemies
data.battleDescription: %user channels his chakra into a focal point in fronnt of him. With a quick hand sign, %user unleashes the chakra in the form of a lazor beam, burning %target to a crisp

data.name: Volt Fang
data.description: A lightning-charged slash that deals damage, boosts the user’s Bukijutsu, and weakens the enemy’s physical prowess.
data.battleDescription: %user lunges forward and slashes %target with a blade cloaked in surging lightning chakra. The strike disorients the enemy as electric currents disrupt their physical control, while empowering the user's Bukijutsu, strength, and momentum.

data.name: Eclipse Cyclone
data.description: A mesmerizing jutsu that amalgamates the user's mastery over both celestial energy and kinetic manipulation. which disorients the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user rotates rapidly, infusing celestial energy around themselves. They create an eclipse-charged cyclone that pulls %target in, briefly disorienting them with darkness, then unleashes an energy burst that propels %target away, staggering them as they land.

data.name: Mental Fortress
data.description: Boosts the user’s damage while weakening the enemy’s offensive strength.
data.battleDescription: %user clasps their hands in a firm seal, eyes locked with unshakable focus. A web of radiant chakra sigils ignites from their body, expanding outward in layered rings that pulse with calculated force. The mental barrier they project doesn’t block attacks physically—it disrupts the intent behind them, unraveling the precision of enemy strikes. As the battlefield warps subtly under this pressure, %user’s resolve sharpens, amplifying their own power while clouding the enemy’s offensive edge.

data.name: Tempest Cleave
data.description: A slicing whirlwind cuts through multiple foes!
data.battleDescription: %user spins swiftly, their weapon or bare hands channeling gale-force winds. The air around them ignites into a slicing vortex, ripping through the battlefield. %target and surrounding enemies are caught in the tempest, battered by razor-sharp wind currents. The relentless storm fades with a final powerful slash, leaving devastation in its wake.

data.name: Primordial Blight
data.description: Elements corrupt and suppress healing abilities.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a malevolent elemental blight of fire, water, wind, earth, and lightning that engulfs %target, scorching their vitality, freezing chakra flow, and corrupting recovery, leaving them weakened and defenseless against %user’s assault.

data.name: Static Flicker
data.description: The user surrounds the target with an illusion of crackling static electricity, making them feel as if they are constantly being lightly shocked.
data.battleDescription: %user channels a burst of electricity into %target, leaving them jolted and weakened

data.name: Flame Infusion
data.description: A burning taijutsu attack that damages the enemy and weakens their stats
data.battleDescription: %user drives a flame-laced strike into %target, searing flesh and spirit alike, leaving their strength smoldering in ruin.

data.name: Martial Movement
data.description: A refined movement technique that evades attacks and reduces the enemy’s offensive power.
data.battleDescription: %user shifts position with disciplined footwork and controlled breathing, weaving through combat with fluid precision. Their movements disrupt %target’s rhythm, dulling the force behind their attacks and reducing the damage they can deliver.

data.name: Gale Force Kick
data.description: A wind-infused taijutsu kick that strikes with explosive force, sending enemies flying.
data.battleDescription: %user channels wind chakra into their legs, the air around them spiraling into a violent vortex. With a sudden burst of movement, they leap and twist, launching a devastating kick toward %target. The moment of impact unleashes a compressed burst of wind that strikes like a cannon blast—tearing through defenses and hurling the enemy backwards.

data.name: Skybreaker Palm
data.description: A crushing palm strike that harms the enemy and increases the damage they take.
data.battleDescription: %user slams %target with the Skybreaker Palm, dealing heavy damage and leaving them vulnerable to even greater punishment.

data.name: Echoing Rift
data.description: A rupture of chakra creates a feedback loop within targets body, amplifying any damage they deal back to themselves.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into a devastating surge, creating a spectral rift that lashes out at %target. The rift tears through the air, embedding itself deep within the enemy’s chakra system. A resonant hum emanates as %target’s actions begin to ripple with unintended consequences.

data.name: Vacuum Palm
data.description: A wind-charged piercing palm strike that leaves the enemy vulnerable to Taijutsu.
data.battleDescription: %user focuses wind chakra into their palm, compressing it into a thin, invisible blade of force. With a single, precise thrust, they drive the strike through the air—and into %target—piercing through defenses without warning. The impact disrupts muscular control and weakens the body’s ability to absorb further physical punishment. After being struck by Vacuum Palm, %target becomes noticeably more vulnerable to Taijutsu techniques, their guard compromised by the razor-thin force still lingering within.

data.name: Tectonic Ascendancy
data.description: Harnessing the primal energy of the earth’s tectonic plates, the user channels a massive surge of chakra to reshape the terrain into a destructive force of nature
data.battleDescription: %user slams their foot into the ground, awakening deep veins of earth chakra that ripple through their body. A surge of raw, grounded power builds beneath their feet, reinforcing their strikes with the weight of the land itself. This technique heightens the user’s affinity with earth, amplifying the force behind all subsequent earth-based attacks.

data.name: Quaking Earth Strike
data.description: Causes the ground to quake and shatter under enemies.
data.battleDescription: %user smashes the earth, sending shockwaves into %target, weakening their defenses against further attacks.

data.name: Forbidden Art: Grave Lotus Detonation
data.description: A suicidal taijutsu form where the user opens every chakra gate for one blooming strike, detonating the impact like a funeral flower.

effects.description: A blooming explosive strike crushes the target.
The lotus impact leaves a deep lingering wound.
The user overclocks their body past safe limits.
The forbidden gates punish the user's body.

data.battleDescription: %user drives both feet into the ground and forces their chakra gates open with a sound like breaking iron. A crimson lotus unfolds around their body as they vanish, reappearing inside %target's guard with a strike that detonates outward in layered petals of force. The impact wounds %target deeply, but the recoil throws %user back with bones shaking and blood-hot chakra leaking from every tenketsu.

data.name: Stunning Jab
data.description: Jab your opponent with a  stunning hit
data.battleDescription: %user's fist crackles with electricity as they surge forward toward %target. Upon impact, a thunderous crack echoes as lightning explodes outward, delivering a devastating and electrifying blow.

data.name: Stone Breaker
data.description: A crushing blow that deals damage and lowers the enemy’s overall damage output.
data.battleDescription: %user twists mid-air and drives a stone-weighted weapon into %target’s torso with brutal force. The sudden blow reverberates through their body, disrupting their chakra flow and reducing the power behind their next attacks.

data.name: Phoenix Flame Strike
data.description: Creates a fiery phoenix that attacks enemies.
data.battleDescription: %user channels phoenix flames into a powerful blow, scorching %target and dampening their offensive power

data.name: Drowning Mire
data.description: A crushing water-based taijutsu that floods the ground and damages enemies caught within the spreading mire.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their palm or foot into the ground, releasing a deep surge of water chakra that seeps into the terrain. In an instant, the area transforms into a heavy, rippling mire that surges outward. As the field floods, %target is struck from below, caught by the sudden pressure and unstable footing. The water doesn’t rise high—but it hits har

data.name: Summoning: Reptile King
data.description: A powerful jutsu that summons the ultimate lizard beast
data.battleDescription: %user gathers their chakra, connecting to their ancient lineage to summon the Reptile King, King of Reptiles.

data.name: Earthquake Slam
data.description: The user channels earth chakra to deliver a powerful Earthquake Slam, causing the ground to shake upon impact and momentarily staggering nearby enemies.
data.battleDescription: %user's decisive slam sends shockwaves through the ground, briefly damaging, staggering and disrupting the balance of %target and nearby foes.

data.name: Shocking Discharge
data.description: A lightning-style ninjutsu that deals damage and stuns the target.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a sudden burst of concentrated lightning from their palm, sending a jagged bolt surging into %target. The impact is sharp and blinding, causing the target’s muscles to seize and their body to convulse. The shock leaves them momentarily immobilized, giving the user an opening to follow up or reposition.

data.name: Cyclone Sweep
data.description: A sweeping leg attack that creates a whirlwind.
data.battleDescription: %user sweeps their leg in a powerful arc, unleashing a ground-level cyclone that trips %target and nearby enemies, leaving them vulnerable.

data.name: Storm Style: Divine Railgun 2
data.description: You fire off an attack at inhuman speeds utilizing the properties of lightning and water's conductivity.
data.battleDescription: %user coats small pebble in water chakra, then using lightning, they supercharge it sending it flying toward %target before they can even react, inflicting massive injury with what seems like just a flick of a finger.

data.name: Thunder Fist
data.description: A lightning-charged punch that deals damage and temporarily stuns the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user channels concentrated lightning chakra into their fist until it pulses with violent static. With a flash-step and explosive lunge, they slam their electrified strike into %target. The chakra discharges on impact, sending a jolt through the target’s nervous system—locking muscles, distorting balance, and interrupting movement. Thunder Fist is not just a blow—it’s a system shock, leaving %target frozen and open for the next attack.

data.name: Tempestual Rend
data.description: A cutting wind attack that deals damage over time.
data.battleDescription: %user summons slicing winds that tear into %target, leaving persistent wounds.

data.name: Herald of the Apocalypse
data.description: A magnificent tale
data.battleDescription: %user begins a speech singing praises of times to come, the great famine, and the endless war, the uncurable pestilence, and the beautiful death of all that lives.

data.name: Thunderbolt Fusillade
data.description: A ninjutsu that summons a barrage of lightning bolts to rain down upon the battlefield.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a relentless storm of thunderbolts at %target, overwhelming and stunning them.

data.name: Acidic Premation
data.description: Release acidic substances into your target's armor, causing burns and extreme discomfort.
data.battleDescription: %user pulls out a paper seal and channels their chakra into it as the seal turns into four green balls. Throwing these four balls at %target, %target easily destroys each ball. Unknowing to them each ball was filled with tiny acidic particles that seeped into their body through their lungs.

data.name: Shocking Torture
data.description: A jutsu that batters the opponent's mind by torturing it with electric shocks.
data.battleDescription: %user locks eyes with %target, casting them into a nightmarish world where crackling lightning surges from every direction. %target's muscles seize as they are bombarded with waves of agonizing electric shocks, each jolt worse than the last.

data.name: Relentless Pursuit
data.description: Byakuho normal attack
data.battleDescription: %user pursues %target with malicious intent, draining chakra to fuel its pursuit

data.name: Lightning Release: Shockwave Kunai
data.description: The user throws kunai infused with lightning chakra, creating small shockwaves upon impact, which can disorient or knock back foes.
data.battleDescription: As %user infuses their kunai with lightning chakra, they hurl it towards %target. Upon impact, the kunai releases a powerful shockwave of electricity, coursing through %target's body and causing them to convulse from the electrical surge. The force of the shockwave also knocks %target back, creating distance between them and %user.

data.name: Raimei Gen
data.description: A lightning-infused genjutsu that damages the target while enhancing the user’s genjutsu output.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a genjutsu that strikes %target’s mind like a bolt of thunder. A flash of light, a roar of psychic lightning—and the illusion crashes down with jarring force. Neural signals distort, and the target reels from imagined pain while %user’s own genjutsu becomes supercharged, amplified by the illusion’s residual current. The echo of thunder leaves a lingering charge in the user’s aura, intensifying their next illusions.

data.name: Whirlpool Grapple
data.description: Uses a whirlpool to trap and immobilize the opponent.
data.battleDescription: %user channels chakra into the ground, summoning a swirling whirlpool around %target. Using the vortex to enhance their grip, %user immobilizes %target in a relentless aquatic hold.

data.name: Mirage of Brine
data.description: A water-element Genjutsu that casts the target into the illusion of being stranded in a vast, foggy sea of brine.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves hand seals with a fluid motion, directing a subtle burst of chakra towards %target. Almost immediately, %target finds themselves in a choking cloud of dense, salty fog. Their skin begins to itch and crack from the dryness, their eyes burn with the sting of salt, and every breath tastes of the sea.

data.name: Abyssal Lure
data.description: Send your opponent to the crushing depths
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into a chain. When the chain makes contact with the target, it wraps around them, ensnaring them tightly. The user then utters an incantation and the chain drags %target downward, sinking rapidly toward the ocean floor. As the target struggles against the weight of the water and the darkness envelops them, their chakra is drained away, leaving them weakened and disoriented.
